title: Establish proposed interface envelope Mock adapters
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, ObserverOS API, database, credential, media, or deployment access
No business data fixtures, business calculation, AI result, permission decision, or authoritative state
No claim that the proposed envelope is an existing ObserverOS API
No DAILY, WEEKLY, or INSIGHT business module implementation
acceptance: Mock adapter represents only the proposed contract envelope and empty or non-authoritative states
Each of LOADING, EMPTY, STALE, UNKNOWN, ERROR, and PERMISSION remains separately representable
Negative fixture verification proves denied, unknown, stale, error, and pending responses are not collapsed
No network access exists in the adapter or verification path
Mock fixtures are explicitly marked as non-authoritative
